Aging of the Digestive System 
The nurse should be aware of considerations for aging clients in connection with the digestive system and the role of 
nutrition. Older adults tend to have a decrease in appetite over younger adults due to comorbidities and/or 
medications that decrease the desire to eat, cause nausea, or create dietary food restrictions due to drug 
interactions. Older adults may experience the following issues:
